item: row 361 group 3: the AI sweeps, the background-AI lane, the AI checks, the perception gate and the AI activity feed follow a language switch
summary: Settings -> Advanced -> AI: the three sweep panels (keyword triage, source tags, perception extraction) with their status lines and saved-run line, the background-AI lane's button, status and hardware note, the AI checks' status and reading, the perception language gate and its per-language switches, and the AI activity feed wrote t() output into ordinary nodes and froze in the language they were drawn in. They now draw through ooLive/ooLiveHtml (row 364) from the reading each was given, and never poll on a switch. The sweep and AI-check buttons carry a translated title, which a data-i18n-dyn marker would freeze, so their labels are written as the English key for the i18n walker to translate. The language switches use one delegated change listener, so a redraw cannot drop them. The saved-run line is now the renderer's lead instead of an insertAdjacentHTML a redraw would lose, and a sweep error is written as text, no longer escaped into textContent. The coordinator node test proves the button and line follow a switch. Ten lines leave configs/i18n_frozen_renderers.txt. No new strings.
